Check fabric composition, stretch, rise, waist, hips and inseam rather than relying on the size letter alone. Confirm whether the listing is for trousers, shorts or underwear. Examine seams, pockets and closures, and check the seller’s measurement and care guidance.

Check model, specifications, charging connector, voltage, plug compatibility and included accessories. Verify whether the item contains a battery and ask the platform about destination and carrier restrictions. Confirm function, warranty and packaging with the seller; do not assume every route accepts electronics.

Check the listed fibre content, fabric thickness, lining, hood or collar and garment measurements. Compare chest, shoulder, sleeve and length with clothing that fits you. Review prints, embroidery, stitching and care instructions; thicker fleece or knitwear may increase packed weight.

Check the listed material, dimensions, colour, fastening and included components. Small product photos can hide details, so inspect the available images and seller description carefully. Confirm whether a box, pouch or extra piece is included and consider its effect on packaging.

Check the packed weight and dimensions, destination, available routes, insurance and prohibited-item rules in Litbuy. If you combine items, compare the final parcel cost and restrictions before submitting. Taxes and customs requirements depend on the destination.

Compare head circumference, depth, fabric and whether the cap is adjustable. Review the brim, stitching, embroidery and shape in the available images. If the shape matters, check the seller’s packaging and ask about protection before shipment.

Compare the fabric composition, advertised weight, fit and size measurements. Inspect product photos for the print position, collar and seams, and check washing instructions. When buying multiple shirts, confirm each colour and size separately before ordering.

Compare the item with your chosen option and look for visible damage, labels, colour, stitching and measurements where available. Photos alone do not guarantee authenticity, fit or quality. Contact the platform before shipping if anything looks wrong.

Compare the seller’s upper and sole materials, construction, closure and size chart. Measure your foot and check whether the listing uses EU, US or another sizing system. Review available photos for the shape, seams and soles; shoe boxes and protective packaging can affect parcel volume.

Confirm exactly which pieces are included and whether the top and bottom share one size. Compare each piece’s measurements, materials and colour with the listing. Review graphics, seams and care guidance, and confirm quantities before placing the order.
